Hi Alicia — great to meet today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps: 

Key takeaways:
- Finexa is evaluating Redwood for customer-facing personalization and internal summarization workloads (estimated ~50k tokens/day).
- Primary decision criteria: security posture (SOC 2, pen test), data retention controls, and procurement-friendly T&Cs.
- Procurement & legal want SOC 2 Type II, recent pen test summary, and sample audit logs. Economic buyer = Tom Reed (VP of Eng).

Proposed next steps:
1) I will share the SOC 2 report, pen test summary, and an example audit logs export by Friday (6/25).
2) You to confirm procurement timeline and any specific redline items for our standard MSA.
3) Marissa will support technical Qs about data residency and retention.

If that aligns, I’ll attach the files to this thread and include a single-slide summary for internal consumption.

Thanks — Ben

Alicia — thanks. Short answers to your questions: 

- Yes, Redwood supports per-customer retention windows. We can configure retention at the workspace level and we support automatic deletion policies (90/180/365 days or custom TTLs).
- Audit logs can be exported on-demand; we also offer a rolling export mechanism to an S3-compatible destination you control for long-term retention.
- Regarding contract redlines, our legal team is used to standard procurement asks; we typically handle data processing addenda (DPA) and SOC 2 attestation references as part of the package.

We’re on track to send the SOC 2 report, pen test summary, and a sanitized sample audit log by EOD Thursday (6/25). Expect a single ZIP with the three items plus a one-page summary.

Ben
